verdict.rationale: ADK supports local/offline running (adk run), a built-in dev/testing UI, and an evaluation framework with test files run against agent-model interactions, which enables testing without hitting a live production deployment. However, there is no explicit mention of a dedicated 'sandbox' environment, test data isolation, or mock/production-data separation. missing for 10: explicit sandbox environment docs, data isolation/mocking guarantees, and confirmation that eval/test runs never touch production data stores.
